beats.say: Tom Rhys Harries stars as Matt Hagen in the new body horror film Clayface.
The psychological thriller is directed by James Watkins.
The screenplay was written by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini.
Naomi Ackie and David Dencik also star in the third film in the DC Universe.
Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan join the cast in this dark DC Comics story.

facts: Clayface is a 2026 American body horror psychological thriller film based on the eponymous character from DC Comics.
Directed by James Watkins from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, it is the third film in the DC Universe (DCU).
Tom Rhys Harries stars as Matt Hagen / Clayface, alongside Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella, and Eddie Marsan.
